orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To achieve a 5-year horizon while adhering to the investment-grade and laddered maturity structure requirements, I recommend a portfolio that spreads out maturities evenly across the next five years. Each year will have a 20% allocation, ensuring no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year. This structure provides a balance of cash flows and reduces reinvestment risk. The selected bonds are all from developed markets and meet the minimum credit rating requirement of BBB+ (S&P) or Baa1 (Moody's). The proposed portfolio maintains a duration of approximately 2.5 years, well below the 7-year warning threshold and the 10-year maximum limit.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% to US Treasury 2.50% 2025, 20% to Microsoft 2.125% 2026, 20% to Johnson & Johnson 2.375% 2027, 20% to Apple 2.250% 2028, and 20% to Pfizer 2.625% 2029. This laddered bond portfolio adheres to the investment-grade and 5-year horizon requirements, with an even distribution of maturities and a portfolio duration of approximately 2.5 years.
